source.title: NFL Next Gen Stats, Next Gen Trends team pages (NFL.com)
source.note: Season usage rates (share of snaps or plays) and NFL percentiles (0-100, higher = uses it more), read from the 32 team pages.

definitions.def_single_high: One deep safety (middle of the field closed)
definitions.def_pressure_no_blitz: Pressure rate with 4 or fewer rushers

how_to_update: Hand-kept. Each Tuesday, read the 32 team pages: the hidden 'Team tendency statistics' lists hold the usage values and the chart labels the percentiles. Save them as slug;oc;dc;value~percentile lines and run scripts/team_analytics/ngs_trends.py (lines file, output, retrieved date, through week). Usage only: the per-trait EPA on the league page is not copied, because coverage-specific EPA did not hold up (coverage_backtest.json).
